responsible.title: Responsible Tourism
responsible.lead: Darjeeling is a fragile Himalayan ecosystem — 2,000 metres of cloud forest, tea terraces and 600 bird species, held together by the families who live in it. Six commitments keep it that way.

principles.d: Carry reusable bottles, bags and cups. Every partner shop refills for free.
Choose homestays over chains. Your money reaches the family that hosts you.
Do not feed or chase wild animals. Observe from a distance and keep moving.
Walk marked trails only. Bushes take four years to recover from trampling.
Ask permission before photographing monasteries, rituals and people.
Keep noise low the hills and their creatures prefer it that way.

responsible.hero_caption: Cloud forest above Manebhanjan, photographed at first light.
responsible.commitments_intro: Ask them of yourself, and of anyone you travel with. Every partner on 1 Darjeeling signs the same six.

gallery.label: Observe from a distance
gallery.caption: Red panda, Singalila — 38 left in the range.

responsible.money_body: 1 Darjeeling directs tourism revenue to Darjeeling-owned businesses — homestays, drivers, tea houses and artisans. No chains, no aggregator margin, no middlemen in Kolkata.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
intro: 1Darjeeling ("we," "us," "our," or "the Platform") operates www.1darjeeling.in (the "Site"), a local marketplace and travel guide connecting visitors with local businesses, guides, and services in Darjeeling. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and protect your information when you use our Site.
By using 1Darjeeling, you agree to the collection and use of information in accordance with this policy.

items: Account information: name, email address, phone number, password, and profile details when you register.

Role/onboarding information: details submitted during our onboarding questionnaire (e.g., whether you're a traveler, local business, guide, or other role), which may be used to assign badges or tiers on your profile.
Contact form submissions: any information you submit through contact or inquiry forms, including your message content.
Listing/business information: if you register as a local business or service provider, details such as business name, location, description, photos, pricing, and contact details.
Payment information: if applicable, payment details are processed by our third-party payment processor; we do not store full card details on our servers.
Communications: records of correspondence if you contact us directly.
Usage data: pages visited, time spent, click patterns, referring URLs.
Device and log data: IP address, browser type, device type, operating system, timestamps.
Cookies and similar technologies: used to remember preferences, maintain sessions, and analyze site usage (see Section 6).
Approximate location: derived from IP address or, if you grant permission, precise device location, to show relevant local listings.

sub.p: If you sign in via a third-party service (e.g., Google), we may receive basic profile information as permitted by that service.

sections.p: We use the information we collect to:
items: Create and manage your account and onboarding profile/badge tier
Connect travelers with local businesses, guides, and services
Operate, maintain, and improve the Site and its features
Respond to inquiries submitted through contact forms
Send administrative messages, updates, and (with consent, where required) marketing communications
Detect, prevent, and address technical issues, fraud, or abuse
Comply with legal obligations

sections.p: We do not sell your personal information. We may share information:
items: With local businesses/service providers: if you make an inquiry or booking, relevant details are shared with the business/provider you're contacting.
With service providers: hosting, database, analytics, and email providers who process data on our behalf under confidentiality obligations.
For legal reasons: if required by law, regulation, legal process, or governmental request, or to protect the rights, property, or safety of 1Darjeeling, our users, or others.
Business transfers: in connection with a merger, acquisition, or sale of assets, your information may be transferred as part of that transaction.
With your consent: for any other purpose disclosed at the time you provide the information.

sections.p: We retain your personal information for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide you services, comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce our agreements. You may request deletion of your account and associated data at any time (see Section 8).

We use reasonable administrative, technical, and physical safeguards to protect your information, including encrypted connections (HTTPS) and access controls on our database. However, no method of transmission or storage is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.
We use cookies and similar technologies to:
items: Keep you logged in
Remember your preferences
Understand how visitors use the Site (analytics)
sections.note: You can control cookies through your browser settings. Disabling cookies may affect some Site functionality.

sections.p: Our Site may contain links to third-party websites (e.g., local business websites, social media, booking partners). We are not responsible for the privacy practices of these third parties. We encourage you to review their privacy policies.
Depending on your location, you may have the right to:
items: Access the personal information we hold about you
Correct inaccurate information
Request deletion of your account and data
Object to or restrict certain processing
Withdraw consent (where processing is based on consent)
Request a copy of your data in a portable format
sections.note: To exercise these rights, contact us at 1darjeelingapp@gmail.com. We will respond within a reasonable timeframe.

sections.p: 1Darjeeling is not intended for use by individuals under the age of 13 (or the applicable minimum age in your jurisdiction). We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe a child has provided us information, please contact us so we can remove it.
If you access the Site from outside India, please note your information will be processed in India, where data protection laws may differ from those in your jurisdiction.

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Changes will be posted on this page with an updated "Last updated" date. Continued use of the Site after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
If you have questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy or our data practices, contact us at:

about.title: Built in Darjeeling, for Darjeeling.
about.lead: The hills already have everything a traveller needs. 1 Darjeeling simply puts it in one place, and makes sure the people who live here are the ones who benefit.
about.mission_body:
Visitors arrive in Darjeeling and end up booking through agents who have never walked these ridges. The homestay owner, the driver who knows every switchback, the shop weaving shawls upstairs, the cafe that has served the same breakfast since 1911 - they are hard to find online, and harder to book.

We put them on one map. No middlemen deciding who gets seen, no commission quietly taken out of a family's earnings.

pillars.d: Every listing belongs to someone who lives and works in Darjeeling. Providers write their own descriptions, set their own prices and keep what they earn.
Homestays, drivers, tea houses, cafes, festivals and Himalayan wildlife - all in one app, instead of scattered across a dozen sites and phone numbers.
The entire site works in English, Nepali, Hindi and Bengali, so a provider in Ghum can list a room as easily as a visitor from Kolkata can book it.
The price a provider sets is the price you see. Nothing is inflated to cover a commission you were never told about.

steps.d: Browse stays, drivers, shops, cafes, festivals and biodiversity across Darjeeling and the hills around it.
Reserve a homestay or a driver online. For shops, cafes and events, get directions and go.
Follow the community pledge - the hills are a fragile ecosystem, and they stay beautiful only if visitors help.

about.providers_body: If you host guests, drive visitors, pour tea or make things by hand, your work belongs here. Listing takes a few minutes and puts you in front of every visitor using the app.
about.team_lead: 1 Darjeeling is designed and built by a small team at Studio 1947.
about.team_note: Built in the hills, for the hills.
about.why_headline: The hills were being booked by people who never walked them.

intro: 1Darjeeling is run by a small team based in the Darjeeling hills. Whether you are a traveller with a question about a booking, a local business wanting to be listed, or someone with a complaint, this page tells you how to reach a person.
We read everything that comes in and reply to most messages within 2 working days.

sections.p: A reply is much faster when the first message already carries what we need:

What you expected to happen, and what happened instead.
A screenshot, if something on screen looked wrong.

sections.p: If you run a homestay, drive for visitors, or keep a café or shop and would like to be listed, you can start from the "For Providers" page on this Site, or write to us at the address above. We will guide you through what is needed, including the documents required to verify your business.

Refund requests, questions about a fee, and reports of a duplicate charge should go to the address above with "Refund" in the subject line. Our Refund & Cancellation Policy sets out what is refundable and the timelines we work to.

In line with the Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020 and the Information Technology Rules, complaints that are not resolved through ordinary support can be escalated to our Grievance Officer.
items: Write to the address below with "Grievance" in the subject line.
Every grievance is acknowledged within 48 hours of receipt.
Every grievance is resolved within one month of receipt.
You will be given a reference for your complaint and told the outcome with reasons.

sections.h: 6. Reporting a Listing or a Safety Concern

sections.note: If you are in immediate danger, contact the local police first. In India, dial 112.

sections.p: Requests to access, correct or delete your personal data are handled under our Privacy Policy. You can delete your account yourself from your dashboard at any time; write to us if you would like us to do it for you.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
intro: 1Darjeeling ("we," "us," "our," or "the Platform") operates www.1darjeeling.in (the "Site"), a local marketplace and travel guide connecting visitors with homestays, drivers, cafés, shops and guides in and around Darjeeling. These Terms & Conditions govern your use of the Site.
By creating an account, making a booking request, listing a business, or otherwise using the Site, you agree to these Terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the Site.

sections.p: We are a discovery and booking-request platform. We introduce travellers to independent local businesses; we do not own, operate, manage or control any homestay, vehicle, café or shop listed on the Site.
items: The contract for your stay, ride, meal or purchase is between you and the local business. 1Darjeeling is not a party to it.
We do not collect the price of the stay, ride or goods. That is settled directly between you and the business, on their terms.
Listing information — photographs, prices, amenities, availability — is supplied by the business. We take reasonable care but cannot guarantee it is complete or current.
We are not responsible for the quality, safety, legality or fitness of anything offered by a listed business, nor for any act or omission of that business.
You must be at least 18 years old to create an account and make a booking request.
You register with a mobile number verified by a one-time password. Keep access to that number secure — anyone who can receive your OTP can access your account.
You are responsible for everything done through your account.
You must give accurate information and keep it up to date. We may suspend or remove accounts that carry false, misleading or impersonating information.

sections.p: All amounts below are what you pay to the Platform. They are separate from, and additional to, whatever you pay the local business for the stay, ride or goods themselves.

sub.h: 3.1 Traveller Support & Convenience Fee — ₹12 per year
sub.p: An annual fee that keeps a traveller account able to make booking requests, save listings and leave reviews. It runs for 365 days from the date of payment and does not renew automatically.
Charged when you confirm a booking request. It covers passing your request to the business and notifying both sides. It is not a deposit, and it is not part of the price of your stay.
Paid once by a local business to activate its listing. It does not expire and is not a commission on bookings.

You may choose to support the Platform with a donation of any amount within that range. A donation is a gift: it buys nothing, grants no access, unlocks no feature, and confers no benefit or priority of any kind.

sections.note: Payments are processed by Razorpay. We do not receive or store your full card details. Fees are stated in Indian Rupees and are inclusive of applicable taxes unless stated otherwise at the point of payment.

items: A booking begins as a request. It is confirmed once the booking confirmation fee is paid, at which point both you and the business are notified.

For homestays, confirmed dates are held exclusively. While a checkout is in progress, those dates are held briefly against other travellers so two people cannot pay for the same room; an abandoned checkout releases them again.

If two travellers reach payment for the same homestay and the same dates at the same moment, only the first can be confirmed. The second booking is cancelled automatically and the fee refunded — see the Refund & Cancellation Policy.
A confirmed booking is a confirmed request to the business. Check-in times, house rules, extra charges and payment for the stay itself are matters between you and the business.

sections.p: A booking may be cancelled by you, by the business, or by us. Fees paid to the Platform are refunded as set out in the Refund & Cancellation Policy, which forms part of these Terms.
sections.note: Any amount you have paid directly to a local business is governed by that business's own cancellation terms, not by ours. We can help you make contact, but we cannot refund money we never received.

items: You may list only a business you own or are authorised to represent.
You must hold every licence, registration and permission the law requires for what you offer, and produce them on request.
Identity and address documents you submit for verification are held privately and are never published — see the Privacy Policy.
Your listing must be accurate. Prices shown must be prices you will honour.
You must honour confirmed bookings, or cancel promptly so the traveller can make other arrangements.
We may suspend or remove a listing that breaks these rules, attracts sustained complaints, or misrepresents what it offers.
You may review a listing only from genuine experience. Paid, traded, fake and retaliatory reviews are not permitted.
You keep ownership of what you post, and grant us a non-exclusive, royalty-free licence to display it on the Site.
Do not post anything unlawful, misleading, obscene, hateful, or infringing someone else's rights.
We may remove content that breaks these rules, and may remove a listing or account that repeatedly does.
Do not scrape, harvest, bulk-download or systematically copy the Site or its listings.
Do not attempt to access accounts, data or systems you have no right to.
Do not interfere with the Site's operation, security or availability.
Do not use the Site to send spam or to solicit users for unrelated purposes.

sections.p: Darjeeling is a living place, not a backdrop. You are expected to respect local customs, private property, protected areas and wildlife, and to follow the guidance on our Travel Responsibly page. Businesses that encourage harm to the environment or to communities may be removed.

To the fullest extent permitted by law, 1Darjeeling is not liable for any indirect, incidental or consequential loss arising from your use of the Site, from any dealing with a local business, or from anything that happens during a stay, ride or visit arranged through the Site.
sections.note: Where liability cannot lawfully be excluded, our total liability to you is limited to the fees you have actually paid to the Platform in the twelve months before the claim. Nothing here limits liability for death or personal injury caused by our negligence, or for fraud.

sections.p: You may stop using the Site and delete your account at any time from your dashboard. We may suspend or close an account that breaches these Terms, misuses the Site, or exposes other users to risk. Fees already paid are refunded only where the Refund & Cancellation Policy says so.

We may update these Terms as the Platform changes. The "last updated" date above always reflects the current version, and continuing to use the Site after a change means you accept it. Changes are not applied retrospectively to a booking already confirmed.
These Terms are governed by the laws of India. The courts at Darjeeling, West Bengal have exclusive jurisdiction over any dispute arising from them.

refunds.title: Refund & Cancellation Policy
intro: This policy explains when money paid to 1Darjeeling is returned, how long it takes, and what falls outside it. It forms part of our Terms & Conditions.

One distinction governs everything below. The fees listed in this policy are paid to the Platform, and this policy covers them. The price of your stay, ride, meal or purchase is paid directly to the local business, and that money is governed by the business's own terms — we never receive it and cannot refund it.

sections.p: A booking can be cancelled at any time before it takes place, from your dashboard, by the business, or by our team.
items: A booking still awaiting payment can simply be cancelled — nothing has been charged.
A confirmed booking can be cancelled by you, by the business, or by us. The ₹1 booking confirmation fee is refunded in full and automatically, whoever cancels and whatever the reason.
If the business cancels on you, we will help you find an alternative wherever we can.

sections.p: Some refunds need no request at all — the Platform issues them itself:
items: Double booking: if two travellers pay for the same homestay and the same dates at the same moment, only the first is confirmed. The second is cancelled automatically and the fee refunded in full, and we tell that traveller what happened.
Cancellation of a confirmed booking: the booking confirmation fee is returned automatically as part of the cancellation.
Duplicate charges: if a technical fault charges you twice for one thing, the duplicate is refunded in full.

sub.p: Refunded in full whenever the booking is cancelled, by any party, at any time before the stay. No request needed.

sub.h: 3.2 Traveller Support & Convenience Fee — ₹12 per year
sub.p: Refundable in full within 7 days of payment if you have not used it to confirm any booking. After 7 days, or once it has been used, it is not refundable — it has already delivered the access it pays for. It runs 365 days and does not auto-renew, so there is no recurring charge to cancel.

Refundable in full within 7 days of payment if your listing has not yet gone live. Once the listing is published and visible to travellers, the fee is not refundable. If we reject or remove your listing for a reason that is not a breach of our Terms, we refund it in full regardless of when.
A donation is a voluntary gift and is not refundable. If you donated by mistake — a wrong amount, a duplicate, an accidental confirmation — write to us within 7 days and we will return it.

items: Refunds always go back to the original payment method. We cannot redirect a refund to a different card, account or wallet.
Refunds are processed through Razorpay, our payment processor.
Once we issue a refund it normally reaches your account in 5 to 7 working days. The final step is your bank's, and we cannot speed it up.
Refunds are made in Indian Rupees for the amount actually charged. Any currency-conversion difference your bank applies is outside our control.

sections.p: For anything not refunded automatically, write to us with your registered mobile number, what you paid for, and the date. Our address is at the end of this policy.
items: We acknowledge every refund request within 2 working days.
We decide, and tell you the outcome with reasons, within 7 working days.
If we approve it, the refund is issued immediately and reaches you in the 5 to 7 working days described above.

sections.h: 6. What This Policy Does Not Cover
items: Money paid directly to a homestay, driver, café or shop. Ask them — their cancellation terms apply, and we will help you make contact.
Costs around a trip that we never charged: travel to Darjeeling, other bookings, time taken off.
Fees where the traveller did not show up, or cancelled after the stay had already begun.
Accounts closed by us for a breach of our Terms.

sections.h: 7. If Something Goes Wrong With a Refund
sections.p: If a refund we have approved has not reached you within 10 working days, or you disagree with a decision, escalate it to our Grievance Officer — the contact details are on the Contact Us page. We will look at it again and reply within 7 working days.
Refund questions and requests go to:
